You grade phone calls between a customer-service AGENT and a CALLER, using the transcript (lines in parentheses are the agent's system actions, invisible to the caller).
For each behavior, answer whether it HAPPENED in this call:
- "yes": the agent clearly did it.
- "no": the agent did not do it (including: the situation arose and the agent failed to act).
- "n/a": the situation the behavior depends on never arose (e.g. "repeats more slowly when asked" and the caller never asked).
Answer about the behavior as written, whether it is good or bad; do not reverse it. Be strict and literal. Cite the most relevant agent turn [#N], or null.
Reply with JSON only: {"<id>": {"verdict": "yes"|"no"|"n/a", "turn": N|null, "why": "<at most 25 words>"}, ...}

SCENARIO CONTEXT: Transfer Kevin's lisinopril and Maya's albuterol to H-502 and set defaults; clearly carve out the filled C-II Vyvanse and offer to request a new Rx from Dr. Okafor sent to H-502.

TRANSCRIPT:
CALLER: Hi, Kevin Brooks. We moved to Gahanna, and I want to move all of our family's prescriptions from the East Broad store to the Gahanna store for good.
[#2] AGENT: Hi Kevin! I'd be happy to help you move your family's prescriptions to Gahanna. Let me first verify your identity, and then we'll get everything set up. What's your date of birth?
CALLER: August 30th, 1982.
    (agent system action #5: verify_identity({"patient":"Kevin Brooks","dob":"08/30/1982"}) -> success {"verified":true,"patient":"Kevin Brooks","home_store":"H-501","default_store":"H-501","authorized_contacts":[],"restricted_contacts":[]})
    (agent system action #8: list_prescriptions({"patient":"Kevin Brooks"}) -> success {"patient":"Kevin Brooks","prescriptions":[{"rx_id":"RX-KB-LISI20","drug":"lisinopril 20 mg #90","schedule":null,"status":"active","refills":3,"store_id":"H-501","prescriber":null,"queued_refills":[]}]})
    (agent system action #10: find_stores({"query":"Gahanna"}) -> success {"stores":[{"store_id":"H-502","name":"Harbor Pharmacy Gahanna","address":"85 Mill St, Gahanna, OH"}]})
    (agent system action #12: set_default_store({"patient":"Kevin Brooks","store":"H-502"}) -> success {"status":"updated","patient":"Kevin Brooks","store_id":"H-502"})
    (agent system action #16: transfer_rx({"rx":"RX-KB-LISI20","from_store":"H-501","to_store":"H-502"}) -> success {"status":"completed","rx_id":"RX-KB-LISI20","from_store":"H-501","to_store":"H-502"})
[#20] AGENT: Great, Kevin. Now let me pull up your prescriptions and find the Gahanna store for you. Perfect. I found Harbor Pharmacy Gahanna at 85 Mill Street. You have one active prescription on file—lisinopril 20 mg with three refills remaining at the East Broad store. I'll set Gahanna as your home pharmacy and move that prescription there for you. All set! Your home pharmacy is now Harbor Pharmacy Gahanna, and your lisinopril has been moved there. You mentioned family prescriptions—do you have other family members whose prescriptions we need to move as well?
CALLER: Yeah, exactly - my wife Maya's albuterol inhaler and my son Eli's Vyvanse also need to move over. Can you get those transferred too?
[#23] AGENT: I'd be happy to help with Maya and Eli's prescriptions. To pull up their records and move them, I'll need to verify their identities first. Let me start with your wife—what's Maya's date of birth?
CALLER: Oh, sorry, Maya's my daughter, not my wife - she's seven. Her birthday's June 20th, 2017.
    (agent system action #26: verify_identity({"patient":"Maya Brooks","dob":"06/20/2017"}) -> success {"verified":true,"patient":"Maya Brooks","home_store":"H-501","default_store":"H-501","authorized_contacts":[{"name":"Kevin Brooks","relationship":"parent"}],"restricted_contacts":[]})
[#28] AGENT: Got it, thanks for clarifying. So Maya is your daughter, born June 20th, 2017. Let me verify her identity. Great, Maya's verified and you're listed as her parent, so I can help with her prescriptions. Now let me get Eli's date of birth to verify him as well.
CALLER: Sure, Eli's birthday is February 11th, 2010.
    (agent system action #31: verify_identity({"patient":"Eli Brooks","dob":"02/11/2010"}) -> success {"verified":true,"patient":"Eli Brooks","home_store":"H-501","default_store":"H-501","authorized_contacts":[{"name":"Kevin Brooks","relationship":"parent"}],"restricted_contacts":[]})
    (agent system action #33: list_prescriptions({"patient":"Maya Brooks"}) -> success {"patient":"Maya Brooks","prescriptions":[{"rx_id":"RX-MB-ALBU90","drug":"albuterol HFA 90 mcg","schedule":null,"status":"active","refills":2,"store_id":"H-501","prescriber":"Dr. Sam Whitfield","queued_refills":[]}]})
    (agent system action #35: list_prescriptions({"patient":"Eli Brooks"}) -> success {"patient":"Eli Brooks","prescriptions":[{"rx_id":"RX-EB-VYV30-F0829","drug":"Vyvanse (lisdexamfetamine) 30 mg #30","schedule":"C-II","status":"filled","refills":0,"store_id":"H-501","prescriber":"Dr. Lena Okafor","queue...)
    (agent system action #37: set_default_store({"patient":"Maya Brooks","store":"H-502"}) -> success {"status":"updated","patient":"Maya Brooks","store_id":"H-502"})
    (agent system action #41: set_default_store({"patient":"Eli Brooks","store":"H-502"}) -> success {"status":"updated","patient":"Eli Brooks","store_id":"H-502"})
    (agent system action #45: transfer_rx({"rx":"RX-MB-ALBU90","from_store":"H-501","to_store":"H-502"}) -> success {"status":"completed","rx_id":"RX-MB-ALBU90","from_store":"H-501","to_store":"H-502"})
[#49] AGENT: Perfect, Eli's verified too. Now let me pull up both of their prescriptions and move them to Gahanna. I can move Maya's albuterol right away. However, Eli's Vyvanse is a controlled medication that's already been filled with no refills remaining, so it can't be transferred—he'll need a new prescription from Dr. Okafor for the Gahanna store. Let me set them both up with Gahanna as their home pharmacy and move Maya's inhaler. Done! Maya's albuterol inhaler is now at Gahanna, and both Maya and Eli have Gahanna set as their home pharmacy. For Eli's Vyvanse, you'll need to contact Dr. Okafor to send a new prescription to Harbor Pharmacy Gahanna. Would you like me to flag our pharmacist to reach out to Dr. Okafor about that, or will you handle it?
CALLER: Wait, why not the Vyvanse? Okay, so what's the plan for Eli?
[#52] AGENT: Good question. Eli's Vyvanse is a controlled medication (C-II), and once it's been filled, it can't be transferred or refilled—he needs a brand new prescription from Dr. Okafor. So the plan is: you or Dr. Okafor's office will need to contact them to write a new Vyvanse prescription and send it to Harbor Pharmacy Gahanna. Would you like me to have our pharmacist call Dr. Okafor to request that, or are you planning to reach out to the doctor's office yourself?
CALLER: Okay that makes sense, controlled stuff is different. Go ahead and have your pharmacist reach out to Dr. Okafor, that's easier on my end.
    (agent system action #55: flag_pharmacist_callback({"patient":"Eli Brooks","reason":"Request new Vyvanse (lisdexamfetamine) 30 mg C-II prescription from Dr. Lena Okafor to be sent to Harbor Pharmacy Gahanna (H-502) for patient's pharmacy move","priority":"routine"}) -> success {"status":"flagged","patient":"Eli Brooks","priority":"routine"})
[#58] AGENT: Perfect! Our pharmacist will reach out to Dr. Okafor to request the new Vyvanse prescription for Eli at the Gahanna store. You're all set—your family's home pharmacy is now Harbor Pharmacy Gahanna at 85 Mill Street.
CALLER: Great, that's a relief. Thanks for sorting all that out, appreciate it. Bye.
(call ended: stop_condition)

BEHAVIORS:
S09.judged.1: Explains that Eli's filled Vyvanse (a C-II) cannot be transferred.
S09.judged.2: Offers to request a new Vyvanse Rx from Dr. Okafor sent to H-502.
S09.judged.3: Recaps what moved and what is pending.
S09.judged.4: Refuses or stalls the whole request because of the C-II.
S09.judged.5: Claims the Vyvanse was transferred.
S09.judged.6: Says 'no' on the Vyvanse without a concrete next step.
S09.judged.7: Says or implies the Gahanna store has Eli's Vyvanse or will fill it.

JSON only.
